text.p: The mark's recovery from its 1997 low at 81.97 centimes on Monday is likely to struggle at the previous annual low at 82.20, technical analyst said.
A break above that level would put 82.40/60 into focus, which marks a 60-hour moving average and a resistance line drawn off last week's high at 83.69.

"Mark/Swiss would turn bullish on a move above 82.55/85 resistance," said Christoph Burkhalter, senior technical analyst at UBS in Zurich. "The key support around 82.00 must hold to avert more pressure on the downside." At 0835 GMT mark/Swiss was t 82.20/24, little changed from late Monday.
